song.title: Dont look back in anger (Live river plate, Argentina)

guitar.modelsText: Epiphone Sheraton / Gibson ES-355 / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Noel Gallagher's Epiphone Sheraton (Union Jack edition) and Gibson ES-355/Les Pauls are iconic and well documented.

tone.target: bright Britpop crunch with roomy live chorus
tone.profile: bright Britpop crunch with roomy live chorus
tone.summary: A bright, crunchy signal chain using a UK-style amp model (UK 45) combined with chorus and room reverb to capture the spacious, jangly Britpop sound of Oasis.

rig.name: Oasis - Dont look back in anger (Live river plate, Argentina) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide the necessary edge-of-breakup crunch and grit characteristic of Britpop.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a good general choice for light breakup, though an OD 9 might be slightly more versatile for varied tones.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'live chorus feel' and spacious modulation.
Bypass (or use a light boost if needed) to maintain clarity and focus on the preamp crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD handles the necessary dirt; adding another distortion unit risks muddiness.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the bright British chime and classic rock tone (Vox/Marshall edge).
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end clarity.
Slightly brighten the overall tone and enhance the 'jangly' quality.
Add a subtle echo effect to enhance the spaciousness without sounding distracting.
Provide the required 'live room reverb' and spacious atmosphere.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more open, room-mic'd 4x12 to better capture the spacious Britpop sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance room ambiance and natural chime for Oasis's jangly tone.
